_how_to_use: The featured hero (section 2) always shows the most recent episode whose status is 'released' or 'dropping_soon'.
Every other 'released' episode appears in the episode index (section 3) with a WATCH link.
video.mp4 / video.poster are paths inside site/public/ (e.g. 'media/lwa_s1e01_the_flip.mp4').
After editing, run:  python3 site/build.py   then commit and deploy.
